summary: The note is a short Wikipedia-style entry on Shervin, a Persian given name also spelled Sherveen or Sherwin. It is mainly a boys' name, though it is occasionally given to girls in forms such as "Shervineh" or "Shervin Dokht". The name is understood to mean both "eternal soul" and "like a lion".
one_line: Shervin is a Persian given name, also spelled Sherveen or Sherwin, mostly used for boys and meaning "eternal soul" or "like a lion".
